title: pseudophyllanthus ovalis
intro: Pseudophyllanthus ovalis, commonly known as Makapunji or Oval-leaf Phyllanthus, is a plant species in the family Phyllanthaceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Pseudophyllanthus ovalis include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
